name: Executor Zygand
summary: At Brill's town hall, Executor Zygand directs Forsaken defenses across central Tirisfal Glades. He reports to the Undercity's high command and coordinates the fight against Scarlet Crusade forces pressing into Forsaken lands.

sections.title: Command in Brill
sections.body: Executor Zygand directs regional defenses from Brill after the Forsaken's awakening in Deathknell. Officers such as Executor Arren and field sentries such as Deathguard Linnea report to him. He gathers scouts' reports and sends able recruits to guard Lordaeron's borders against encroachment.

sections.title: The War on the Crusade
sections.body: The Scarlet Crusade's presence across Tirisfal Glades commands Executor Zygand's attention. He sends agents against Crusader scouts, encampments, and forward bases, keeping the zealots from gathering enough strength to threaten the approaches to the Undercity.

faq.answer: Executor Zygand is a senior Forsaken officer based in Brill, Tirisfal Glades. He commands local Deathguard garrisons, receives reports from lower-ranking officers, and directs campaigns against local threats.

faq.q: Where can I find Executor Zygand?
faq.answer: Executor Zygand can be found inside or near Brill's main town hall. Brill is the central Forsaken settlement in Tirisfal Glades, just north of the Undercity.

faq.q: What is Zygand's main goal in Tirisfal Glades?
faq.answer: Executor Zygand's main goal is to direct the regional war against the Scarlet Crusade. He tracks the zealots across Tirisfal and orders their encampments and leadership dismantled before they can march on the Undercity.
Executor Arren and field sentries such as Deathguard Linnea report to Executor Zygand. Arren directs initial recruits in Deathknell, while Linnea patrols Tirisfal Glades' main crossroads.

faq.q: Does Executor Zygand handle rogue undead threats?
faq.answer: Yes. Executor Zygand also issues regional bounties against feral undead and dangerous rogue scavengers that endanger travel through the glades, including the corpse-stealing gnoll Maggot Eye.

faq.q: What rank does an 'Executor' hold among the Forsaken?
faq.answer: Among the Forsaken, an Executor holds authority as a regional governor and military commander. Executors manage settlements, command local Deathguard units, and enforce Queen Sylvanas's rule across Lordaeron's contested regions.

angles.text: As a Forsaken venturing out of Deathknell, you meet Executor Zygand as a representative of the Undercity's wider military authority, bringing new citizens into active service against their bitterest enemies.
As a traveler from Kalimdor in Tirisfal Glades, you can see in Zygand the disciplined military leadership guiding the Forsaken's struggle to secure Lordaeron.
